title: Check valve.
officialText: Where the top of the storage tank is above the fill pipe terminal, the fill pipe shall be connected to the top of the tank and provided with a shutoff valve and swing check valve, both of which shall be located at the fill pipe terminal. The shutoff valve and swing check valve may be installed in an accessible location inside the building at or below the level of the fill pipe terminal.
